accepted.text: Sara has been to the tool shed and has returned with a pair of gloves.
Noah has gone to the other side of the garden to find a rake; he is not back yet.
The children have been in the garden for two hours, and nobody has complained about the work.
They have shared snacks and have told stories while they plant.
The garden has changed the empty lot.
Last month, the ground looked dry and forgotten; now the first leaves have appeared.
Sara has taken several photos, but she took the first one on Monday, when the class started the bench.
